blurb: Guests solve a series of story-based puzzles within 60 minutes to escape the room. Each game is private to the group and guided by a Gamemaster via audio/visual systems. The experience is designed to be fun, challenging, and safe, suitable for children 9 and older with adult supervision recommended for younger children.
extraNote: Games are private to your group; no mixing with other parties · You can add and pay for additional players upon arrival · Cancellation deposit required 2 days prior for private events · Guests can leave the room at any time via emergency exit · Building is wheelchair accessible with elevator; some game elements may limit full accessibility · Parking free on weekends and after 4pm weekdays in lot across street; validation available for parking tickets · Enter the lobby of the Northworks Building and head downstairs, down the hall to the right.
